## About the trip

This itinerary brings together ancient Maya cities, colonial architecture, highland markets, lakes, rainforest and the Caribbean coast. Over 11 days, you'll travel through Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras and Belize, visiting archaeological sites and getting to know the traditions of communities living in the region today.

Antigua is regarded as one of Central America's oldest and most beautiful cities. Chichicastenango is known for its colourful Indigenous market. Lake Atitlán lies in the crater of an extinct volcano, and the Río Dulce winds through rainforest to the Caribbean coast. In Belize, the trip ends at Caracol, the largest Maya city in the country.
